newsitem.title: RUSSIA: YUKOS shareholders "actively" took up rights issue.
newsitem.headline: YUKOS shareholders "actively" took up rights issue.

text.p: Shareholders in oil group NK YUKOS took up this month's rights issue actively, and results of the issue will be published following a board meeting on November 5, a YUKOS spokesman said on Thursday.

"The results will be announced after the board of directors. In the meantime we can only say that shareholders actively made use of their preferential right to buy shares," spokesman Alexei Gorshkov told Reuters.

YUKOS issued 579.96 million shares, with a face value of four roubles each but priced at 909 roubles, to raise authorised capital to 8.95 billion from 6.63 billion roubles. The rights issue ran from September 30 to October 29.
It was the first of three issues intended to raise about $100 million each to pay off part of its wage and tax arrears.
YUKOS owes 351.3 billion roubles in back wages and around four trillion roubles in taxes.
YUKOS is one of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years. It is controlled by Bank Menatep.
Its main operating unit is Yuganskneftegaz YFGA.RTS 0#YFGA.RUO, Russia's second biggest oil production company, in which it holds 51 percent.
